description: Today the release-notes → Changeset v0.2 flow only fires for Forward Networks (hardcoded via integration.slug === 'forward-networks' + the static src/data/fwdnetworks.json scrape). Every other integration in provider-registry.js (Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Twilio, SendGrid, GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Azure, OpenAI, etc.) has no release-notes path at all — clicking them produces the 'No versions discovered yet' dead-end. Generalize the flow: define a ReleaseNotesPort, implement per-provider adapters, wire via composition-root, and replace the FWD hardcoding in IntegrationHeader with a port lookup.
feature: Generalize release-notes parsing across every registered integration

phases.description: Define ReleaseNotesPort in src/core/ports/. Shape the contract around the existing fwdnetworks-diff JSON so the two-version aggregation path in IntegrationHeader keeps working unchanged. Add ReleaseNotesService use-case in src/core/usecases/ that holds a slug→adapter map, parallel to DiscoveryService.
phases.name: Port + registry scaffold

ReleaseNotesService use-case with Map<slug, adapter> lookup + aggregate-range method

phases.description: Move the current static fwdData.versions + aggregation logic out of IntegrationList.jsx/IntegrationHeader.jsx and into src/adapters/secondary/forward-networks-release-notes-adapter.ts implementing ReleaseNotesPort. Keep the offline fallback (src/data/fwdnetworks.json) as the adapter's data source.
phases.name: Refactor Forward Networks into a proper adapter

phases.name: Generalize IntegrationHeader to use the port

Each adapter bundles a per-provider scraper (or consumes static JSON under src/data/). Scripts/analyze-release-notes.js should be generalized to scripts/release-notes-scraper/ with one module per provider.
